parameters.query: SELECT id, name, role, is_active FROM users WHERE id = $1

SELECT 'V' AS kind, v.id, NULL AS code, u.name AS user_name, u.phone, u.photo_key, v.id_type, v.id_last4, v.name_on_id, v.id_front_key, v.id_back_key, v.selfie_key, DATE_FORMAT(v.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS submitted_at, NULL AS t_name, NULL AS sport, NULL AS area, NULL AS city, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS entry_fee, NULL AS max_teams, NULL AS logo_key, NULL AS organizer_verified FROM identity_verifications v JOIN app_users u ON u.id = v.user_id WHERE v.status = 'PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'L', t.id, t.code, o.name, o.phone, o.photo_key, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, DATE_FORMAT(t.published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), t.name, t.sport, t.area, t.city, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), t.entry_fee, t.max_teams, t.logo_key, o.is_verified FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC_PENDING' AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY submitted_at
